handoff.objective: Close the sole v4 blocker by auditing the v5 source-subtotal plus target-delta reconciliation and current target-blind boundary.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether source implementation, but not execution, is now authorized without circularly changing pending status first.
constraints: Check the exact four reconciliation equations.
Confirm the target delta is absent from source-visible files.
Treat pending status as the output of this gate, not an input defect.
Preserve the toy, restricted, model-bound claim.
completion_gate: No target schedule or digest enters the source process.
GO authorizes source implementation only, followed by implementation review before run.
handoff.return_format: Use repository handoff headings and return immediately.
